instruction: A candid full shot photograph of a spacious indoor studio with a dark red carpeted floor and white walls. On the left, the woman in the white patterned t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands angled away from the camera, facing right. On the right, the man in the dark polo shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands facing left. They are shaking hands, holding their right hands clasped together in the center. Both look at each other. The scene is illuminated by bright overhead fluorescent lights, creating a neutral color palette with a prominent red floor.
